channel.title: Xǐqìng: Chinese New Year Visual Narratives | Alien Studio
channel.description: A 40-photograph celebration of Chinese New Year inspired by paper-cut master Lu Shengzhong. Vibrant dragons, cultural heritage, and festive visual stories.

item.title: Xǐqìng Exhibition: A Modern Tribute to Chinese Paper Art
item.description: Explore Xǐqìng, a photo collection inspired by Lu Shengzhong, capturing Chinese New Year's spirit through paper-cut dragons and cultural narratives.
